selection_rule: Include every row whose matching cached poster passes PIL.verify; no filtering on revenue/ROI outcomes beyond original cohort filters.
acquisition_order: Fixed seed42 shuffled full cohort; cache began with8 oldest films before shuffle.
missingness: HTTP403 access denials, HTTP404 unavailable assets and unattempted images after broad access failures; downloads stopped after broad access failures; one denied URL was inadvertently retried by an in-flight batch and remained denied.
limitation: Complete-case cohort is selected by image availability/acquisition and may differ from full cohort; ablations must use identical complete-case train/validation/calibration/test rows.
